text:
mike_support: Customer Jane reported a 403 when calling /v1/generate, message shows 'invalid api key'. They can reproduce consistently since yesterday. Posting logs and repro steps.
customer_jane: repro steps: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-customer-xxx' -d '{\"prompt\":\"hi\"}' -> 403 + body 'invalid api key'. Worked last week after plan upgrade.

mike_support: Can you paste the full response body and headers (sanitized)? Also which org/tenant id?
customer_jane: resp: {\"error\":\"invalid api key\",\"code\":403} headers: x-request-id: rq_0a1b2c, x-region: us-west-2. Org: acme-tenant-451
jordan_se: I pulled logs for rq_0a1b2c: routed to authsvc v2 -> token validated OK, key_id=key_987. Then entitlement-check returned DENY. Error: ENTITLEMENT_PLAN_MISMATCH. System mapped DENY -> standard 403 with message 'invalid api key'. That's misleading.
emily_billing: Hmm, billing shows tenant acme-tenant-451 upgraded to Pro yesterday but the plan sync job failed to write the entitlement change to cache. In billing logs: "sync_job: status=partial_failure, updated=0, err=timeout contacting entitlement-api" at 2026-03-15T14:02:10Z
sam_ops: Which component is responsible for mapping entitlement errors -> 403 payload? If it's authsvc, we should change error code to FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE or 402-ish to be clearer. For now we need a short-term fix: propagate plan status TTL refresh for this tenant.
mike_support: Customer needs immediate unblocking. Emily, can you force a resync for acme-tenant-451 and confirm entitlement cache update? Jordan, can you add a temporary translation rule to authsvc to surface 'plan gated' in response body so frontends show the right UI?
emily_billing: Running manual resync now: `POST /internal/billing/sync?tenant=acme-tenant-451` -> 202 accepted. Watching events.
qa_bot: event stream: billing-sync:tenant=acme-tenant-451 status=success commit=42f7e; entitlement-cache: refresh key=acme-tenant-451 ttl=3600
jordan_se: Updated a hotfix on authsvc (non-prod first) to map ENTITLEMENT_DENY -> {\"error\":\"feature_unavailable_for_plan\",\"code\":403,\"meta\":\"plan:free -> requires pro\"}. Will promote to prod after smoke tests.
customer_jane: Thanks — can you tell me if I should reissue keys or just retry? We're in production customer-facing flow.
mike_support: No need to rotate keys. Once entitlement cache shows the new plan, your calls should succeed. If not, send a new x-request-id and we'll trace.
emily_billing: Confirmed sync success and entitlement now shows plan=pro for tenant in cache. Please retry, Jane.
customer_jane: Retry now... curl returned 200, model responded. :tada: Thanks all!
sam_ops: Follow-ups: 1) Add alert for sync_job partial failures and auto-retry 2) Make entitlement->auth error mapping explicit so UX surfaces plan-gating instead of misleading 'invalid api key' 3) Add a dashboard showing last successful entitlement refresh per tenant.
jordan_se: Filing ENG ticket: ENG-6982 "Authsvc should surface entitlement failures distinctly and include plan info in error meta". I'll attach logs and the hotfix diff.
mike_support: I'll reply to the customer thread with root cause and mitigation steps, and link to the postmortem if needed. Great quick turnaround :thumbsup:
emily_billing: Also adding a migration job to backfill tenants with recent billing changes to avoid race during heavy sync windows.
customer_jane: Appreciate the quick help. Please keep me posted if anything else needed on our side.
